knowledge: Member readings: a member's full name is the first name plus the last name (questions name members by full name); the member's contact number is the phone column; a member holds a position in the club (e.g. President, Vice President, Member) and has a major (the major name).

Event readings: an event is named by its event name; its type distinguishes meetings from other events (e.g. game events), its status is Open / Closed / Planning (a closed event is the one whose status is Closed), and "attended by more than N members" counts the members' attendance records for that event.

Money readings: a budget line has an amount (the money allocated), a category (e.g. Advertisement, Food), an event status and the spent figure; an expense records its cost, its description (what was bought) and whether it was approved; "the budget spent" is the amount actually spent and "remaining" the unspent part (a negative remaining means the budget was exceeded).

Income readings: funds received are recorded with an amount, a source (e.g. Fundraising) and the date received; "the top source of funds" and totals read as the largest source / the sum of the amounts.

Time readings: a date such as 2019/9/14 is written YYYY-MM-DD in the data; the year of a date is its first four characters (a month such as September 2019 spans its first and last day); "on <date>" filters the record with that date.

Percentages and ratios count the same entities on both sides (members, events or expenses) times 100 for a percentage, and divided for a ratio (e.g. spend-to-budget); "exceeding the budget the most" is the smallest remaining figure.
